title: Keto Canadian Chewy Bites
description: A keto dessert recipe with a chewy center and a crunchy exterior, made with drenched pasta and a hint of Canadian flavor.

ingredients.name: Sweetener (such as Erythritol or Monk Fruit)

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the pasta, granola, and coconut oil until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, sweetener, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the pasta mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into small balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
